lambda_selection: Candidates fit the two learners separately on each training fold and decode the same held-out scans. Require mean common-window GEV in each learner at least .95 of lambda=0, S0 short-episode recall at least lambda=0 minus .05, and mean per-cohort minimum state coverage at least .015. Among eligible candidates maximize mean latent ARI over learners and conditions minus .25 times the mean absolute adjusted C1/C2 switch-rate error in the two S5 scenarios divided by the latent switch rate. Prefer the lower penalty on exact score ties; stress penalty is diagnosed only.
method_selection: Prospectively gate each method on its whole six-test core Holm family. All core members must be estimable in at least 90% of cohorts per setting, and any setting allowing too many small clusters fails. The upper two-sided Wilson 95% bound for the proportion with any rejection must not exceed .10 under S0 and .15 under either S5 condition. Among passers rank by blinded real disjoint-training label ARI, then mean matched-map absolute r, then synthetic clean-process latent ARI for S0 through S3. Report temporal effect recovery separately. No eligible method yields null; A0/A3 may still serve as predefined descriptive interval references.
simulation_interpretation: Under S5 the latent process is identically distributed across groups. Rejection in GEV or margin measures sensitivity to noise-driven measurement differences rather than a type I error for equal measured feature means. Coverage and time effects use the planted latent sequence, and the common-window estimate has a matched-window latent comparator.
